objective_summary: Choose the safest credible source for the first directional pairwise labels without weakening independence or holdout blindness.

context_facts.statement: The provisioned labeler v1 is separately hosted, signs bundles with GitHub OIDC and intentionally emits only TIE or ABSTAIN.
The pairwise supervision contract forbids inventing counterfactual outcomes and requires labels from an independent fixed specification.
The evaluation protocol forbids training access to the holdout and requires reproducible pre-registered evidence.

constraints.statement: The label source must not receive selected direction, outcomes, propensities, verdicts, split names or holdout content.
Every durable label must bind the exact pair input, JudgeSpec version, producer identity and externally witnessed integrity proof.
Directional labels must express defensible semantic comparison rather than merely repeat producer-authored numeric preferences.

candidates.sanitized_summary: Extend the separate signer with a frozen deterministic rule engine over the structured projection.

facts.statement: The existing separate workflow already proves canonical execution and keyless signing for a frozen deterministic JudgeSpec.
Rules over producer-authored fields can restate producer preferences instead of providing independent semantic judgment.
This direction needs no inference provider, human review queue or new runtime credential.
A closed rule engine cannot reliably interpret arbitrary semantic summaries unless the producer pre-encodes the comparison.
A new JudgeSpec version can be disabled without changing the HOK-234 projection or authority contracts.

candidates.sanitized_summary: Use an external language model behind the separate signed workflow with a frozen prompt, model identifier and conservative abstention policy.

facts.statement: A language model can compare bounded semantic summaries and dimension-specific facts without receiving post-action fields.
Provider drift and non-deterministic inference can break the exact repeated-run requirement even with a fixed prompt and temperature.
This direction requires a separately governed provider credential, usage budget and retention policy.
The model can synthesize tradeoffs across all five declared dimensions and provide reasons for abstention.
The provider call can be removed while preserving the signed bundle boundary and all existing contracts.

candidates.sanitized_summary: Require a named independent human reviewer to apply a frozen rubric and submit a signed structured judgment through the separate repository.

facts.statement: A reviewer can understand the semantic alternatives and judge evidence that a closed rule engine cannot interpret.
A single reviewer introduces subjective and operator-correlated bias unless blinded repetition and disagreement handling are specified.
Every comparison consumes manual review time and limits corpus throughput.
A human can expose ambiguity, missing evidence and rubric defects instead of forcing a directional answer.
The review process can stop without changing the projection contract or granting execution authority.
